description: Swings an incoming phasor, pushing the steps within each group late or early

params.text: How many steps the phasor cycle is cut into, 1 to 64, at 4 by default
Scales the STEPS CV before it is added to the knob, -1 to +1; at full depth 5V spans the whole 64-step range
How many steps are treated as one swing group, 1 to 64, at 2 by default; the swing is applied across that group
Scales the GROUPING CV before it is added to the knob, -1 to +1; at full depth 5V spans the whole 64-step range
How hard the swing pushes; centred gives even steps, one way puts the upstep early and the other puts it late
Scales the SWING CV before it is added to the knob, -1 to +1
Adds a random amount to the swing on each group: none at all fully counter-clockwise
Scales the VARIATION CV before it is added to the knob, -1 to +1

inputs.text: Modulates the step count, scaled by the attenuverter and added to the knob
Modulates the group size, scaled by the attenuverter and added to the knob
Modulates the swing amount, scaled by the attenuverter and added to the knob
Modulates the variation amount, scaled by the attenuverter and added to the knob
Above 1V the swing runs; below that the phasor passes through untouched. With nothing patched here the swing runs

outputs.text: A 0-10V ramp across each step of the swung phasor
10V over the first half of each swung step, and 0V the rest of the time

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
